senses.gloss: m. (פָּרַט) units, odd sum, detail number.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 23:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIII</cite> <he>חמשה עשר אלף ופ׳</he> fifteen thousand and an odd sum (less than one thousand); [read:] <he>וכמה הוא פ׳ שבע מאות ושמונים ותשע</he> and how much was that odd sum (over fifteen thousand)? Seven hundred and eighty-nine. Y. Taan. IV, end, 64ᶜ <he>היו מוצאין עצמן … ופ׳</he> (not <he>עצמו</he>) they found that they had lost upwards of fifteen thousand; Midr. Sam. ch. XXXII, end <he>ט״ו אלף בפ׳</he> (corr. acc.); Lam. R. introd. (R. Z’ʿera) (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 5:1:4">Y. Naz. V, beg. 53ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:3:2">Y. Shek. II, 46ᶜ</cite>, sq. <he>במכנס פ׳</he> (not <he>פרוטרות</he>) when he piles up the coins one by one.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 5a:15">Bekh. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מנאן הכתוב אלא בפ׳</he> the Scripture counts them only by single Manehs (not by Kikkars); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:4:10">Y. Snh. I, end, 19ᵈ</cite> <he>ואתעביד ליה פ׳</he> it is counted by single Manehs.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 4:17">Tosef. B. Mets. IV, 17</cite> if he says, <he>הילך מנה ואינו יכול לעמוד על הפ׳</he> ‘here is a Maneh for thee (as thy share in the profits)’, but is unable to give a detailed account; Y. ib. V, 10ᵇ <he>שאינו … כפ׳</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 2:10">Tosef. Maas. Sh. II, 10</cite> <he>אלא אם כן יש עמו פראטרוט</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>פרוטרט</he>; corr. acc.) unless he has with him an itemized account (of the ready money and of the value of the products).
